interpretation: Appendix J frozen correctness head calibrated on source with Soft-ECE, followed by Algorithm 2 in-training top-label ECL. The square-root boundary is stabilized by adding 1e-12 inside sqrt.

protocol.source: all MNIST train+test plus all USPS train+test

required_evidence: exact dataset hashes and full sample counts
verdict_rule: A single seed remains insufficient to VERIFY a ten-run summary. It is compatible only if both ECE values fall within paper mean plus or minus two printed standard deviations and ECL lowers ECE. A mismatch is not FALSIFICATION because the paper omits seeds and the ECL cross-entropy coefficient, and the stabilization is a declared repair.
